info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-List Human Resource Management Employee Data Managements-spec
info.description: The Employee Data Retrieval API provides access to comprehensive employee information within the Human Resource Management system. This endpoint allows users to retrieve details about employees, enhancing visibility into workforce management. Typical consumers of this API include HR personnel, payroll systems, and workforce analytics applications. By facilitating seamless access to employee data, organizations can streamline their HR processes and improve decision-making based on accurate employee insights.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch employee data from the human resource management system. You can obtain various details regarding employees, including their roles, contact information, and employment history.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve specific employee data from the human resource management system. It must include all necessary filters and parameters to ensure accurate data retrieval.

200.description: Request completed successfully, returning employee data.

ListHumanResourceManagementEmployeeDataM.description: This schema represents the request body for the GET operation in the Employee Data Management API. It typically contains the query parameters formatted as a JSON string.
